variant_labels.value: Babylonian Collection at the Yale Peabody Museum

notes: Verified current institutional collection identity formally affiliated with the Yale Peabody Museum in 2017. The umbrella institution includes multiple catalog-prefix and acquisition-history groups, including YBC, NBC, MLC, GCBC, NCBT, NCBS, and RBC; it is not equated with one legal entity, one ancient corpus, one bibliographic Collection record, every Peabody record, or the 2019 exhibition catalog. Live holdings counts vary by date and scope and are not admitted as exact membership.
